map.由引力常数与半径求逃逸速度 使用指南: Escape velocity from gravitational constant and radius user guide
map.逃逸速度计算器，输入天体引力参数 μ 与半径 r，按 v=√(2μ/r) 求脱离: Escape velocity calculator: input celestial gravitational parameter mu and radius r; find the minimum velocity to escape the celestial body's gravity by v=sqrt(2*mu/r), for aerospace orbit design.
map.输入引力参数 μ 与天体半径 r，求逃逸速度。: Input gravitational parameter mu and celestial radius r to find escape velocity.
map.由天体引力参数 μ 与表面（或起点）半径 r 算逃逸速度 v_e=√(2μ/r): Compute escape velocity v_e = sqrt(2*mu/r) from celestial gravitational parameter mu and surface (or start) radius r.
map.对比地球/月球/火星的逃逸速度，评估探测器起飞难度。: Compare escape velocities of Earth/Moon/Mars to assess probe launch difficulty.
map.已知逃逸速度，反推需要的最小轨道高度动能。: Given escape velocity, back-calculate the minimum orbital-altitude kinetic energy needed.
map.：地球引力参数 μ=3.986×10¹⁴ m³/s²、半径 r=6.371×10: : Earth gravitational parameter mu=3.986x10^14 m^3/s^2, radius r=6.371x10^6 m. v_e=sqrt(2 x 3.986e14/6.371e6)=sqrt(1.251e8) approx 11186 m/s approx 11.2 km/s. That is the second cosmic velocity.
map.逃逸速度和第一宇宙速度什么关系？: What is the relationship between escape velocity and first cosmic velocity?
map.第一宇宙速度（圆轨道）v_c=√(μ/r)，逃逸速度 v_e=√2·v_c。地球: First cosmic velocity (circular orbit) v_c = sqrt(mu/r), escape velocity v_e = sqrt(2)*v_c. Earth v_c approx 7.9 km/s, v_e approx 11.2 km/s, differing by sqrt(2).
map.在轨道高度上逃逸需要多大速度？: How much velocity is needed to escape at orbital altitude?
map.起点半径 r 越大（越高），v_e 越小。从地球同步轨道高度逃逸，所需附加速度远: The larger the start radius r (the higher), the smaller v_e. Escaping from geostationary altitude needs far less added velocity than the surface 11.2, because part of the orbital velocity is already had. This tool computes by the given r.
